flavor.zianmanager.flame_spear.line1: Forged where the sun first touched stone.
flavor.zianmanager.flame_spear.line2: Its ember remembers an age without winter.
flavor.zianmanager.void_staff.line1: A shard of silence between the stars.
flavor.zianmanager.void_staff.line2: A forgotten voice sleeps within its crystal.
flavor.zianmanager.gladiator_sword.line1: Its steel bears the names of the undefeated.
flavor.zianmanager.gladiator_sword.line2: Glory is won; it is never bestowed.
flavor.zianmanager.altar_ancientblade.li: Guarded beneath the roots of a lost kingdom.
flavor.zianmanager.altar_dragonrend.line: Tempered beneath the shadow of ancient wings.
The gold upon its edge has known no king.
flavor.zianmanager.altar_withersym.line1: Born among the ashes of a broken crown.
flavor.zianmanager.altar_withersym.line2: Its shadow seeks one final dawn.
flavor.zianmanager.altar_omen.line1: A dark star marked its birth.
flavor.zianmanager.altar_omen.line2: Fate falls silent before its crystal point.
flavor.zianmanager.altar_tide.line1: A relic of a throne lost beneath the sea.
flavor.zianmanager.blue_hammer.line1: Carved in the ice of an eternal mountain.
flavor.zianmanager.blue_hammer.line2: Its echo travels the chambers of the world.
flavor.zianmanager.green_hammer.line2: The woodland spirit endures beneath its metal.
flavor.zianmanager.grey_hammer.line1: The final work of the stone smiths.
flavor.zianmanager.grey_hammer.line2: A fortress once rested upon its steel.
flavor.zianmanager.red_hammer.line1: Born in a forge that never grew cold.
flavor.zianmanager.red_hammer.line2: The mountain remembers the mark of its fire.
flavor.zianmanager.altar_amaxe.line1: Violet crystals crown its ancient steel.
flavor.zianmanager.altar_amaxe.line2: It witnessed the fall of a golden age.
flavor.zianmanager.altar_ampick.line1: A song lies hidden beneath every stone.
flavor.zianmanager.altar_ampick.line2: Its crystal hears the secrets of the earth.
flavor.zianmanager.warrior_reskin.line1: Forged for the last king of dawn.
flavor.zianmanager.warrior_reskin.line2: Its edge still demands a vow of valor.
flavor.zianmanager.warrior_reskin.line3: May your steel remember who you are.
flavor.zianmanager.necromancer_reskin.li: Its shadow shields those who defy the end.
flavor.zianmanager.ninja_reskin.line1: It kept a thousand secrets beneath a blue sky.
flavor.zianmanager.ninja_reskin.line2: Only the moon knows its ancient names.
flavor.zianmanager.ninja_reskin.line3: A single flash is enough to write destiny.
flavor.zianmanager.chainsaw.line1: Born in the forges of a forgotten war.
flavor.zianmanager.chainsaw.line2: Its teeth sing the twilight of kingdoms.
flavor.zianmanager.chainsaw.line3: The will of iron never breaks.
flavor.zianmanager.flame_spear.line3: An ancient oath awakens in your hands.
flavor.zianmanager.void_staff.line3: An ancient oath awakens in your hands.
flavor.zianmanager.gladiator_sword.line3: An ancient oath awakens in your hands.

flavor.zianmanager.altar_ampick.line3: An ancient oath awakens in your hands.
flavor.zianmanager.common_key.line1: A small oath carved in iron.
flavor.zianmanager.common_key.line2: It holds every adventurer's first step.
flavor.zianmanager.rare_key.line1: Its metal remembers the light of a new day.
flavor.zianmanager.rare_key.line2: A blue glow rests among its runes.
flavor.zianmanager.epic_key.line1: Born when night embraced the sun.
flavor.zianmanager.legendary_key.line1: It guarded the treasures of forgotten kingdoms.
flavor.zianmanager.legendary_key.line2: Gold keeps promises no one ever broke.
flavor.zianmanager.loot_common_crate.lin: It gathers the tales of those who depart.
Every journey begins with a hope.
Interact to receive its configured loot.
flavor.zianmanager.loot_rare_crate.line1: First light caresses its ancient seal.
flavor.zianmanager.loot_rare_crate.line2: Its secrets await the patient traveler.
flavor.zianmanager.loot_rare_crate.line3: Interact to receive its configured loot.
It outlived the twilight of a hundred crowns.
Its wealth sleeps beneath a golden oath.
Interact to receive its configured loot.
flavor.zianmanager.loot_cosmetic_crate.l: A mirror of the sky holds its colors.
Interact to receive its configured loot.
flavor.zianmanager.loot_vote_crate.line1: Dawn renews the promises of the road.
flavor.zianmanager.loot_vote_crate.line2: Each day opens a page of your story.
flavor.zianmanager.loot_vote_crate.legen: THE GIFT OF A NEW DAY
flavor.zianmanager.loot_vote_crate.line3: The administrator configures its loot and waits.
flavor.zianmanager.locked_common_crate.l: Its hinges guard an iron pact.
Only a key of the road breaks its seal.
flavor.zianmanager.locked_rare_crate.lin: Blue runes protect the light of dawn.
Its promise awaits an aurora key.
flavor.zianmanager.locked_epic_crate.lin: Night and sun guard its interior.
An ancient shadow watches the lock.
flavor.zianmanager.locked_legendary_crat: The last kingdom entrusted its legacy here.
Only the worthy know its golden key.
flavor.zianmanager.reimagined_wooden_axe: Every strike opens a path through the forest, forged in the ancestral root.
flavor.zianmanager.reimagined_wooden_pic: Its song awakens the secrets of the stone, forged in the ancestral root.
flavor.zianmanager.reimagined_wooden_sho: The earth reveals forgotten paths, forged in the ancestral root.
flavor.zianmanager.reimagined_wooden_swo: Its edge guards the traveler's courage, forged in the ancestral root.
